actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution was far below 30% of the endowment, so Conditional Cooperation requires contributing the full wallet (2.21). Round 20 is a broadcast round, so a norm message is sent.
